timeline_events.description: Mika becomes commander of the strike force

actions.action: calls out to the assembled remnants of Geralt's army
actions.consequence: the crowd disperses with purposeful energy

actions.action: descends from the platform to begin her own preparations
actions.consequence: she finds her armor and begins gearing up

dialogue.speaker: Mika
dialogue.addressee: the assembled remnants of Geralt's army
dialogue.quote_excerpt: Listen up, I know what you're thinking. Geralt's gone. We've lost our leader.

arc_position.role_in_arc: setup | escalation | revelation | reversal | resolution | aftermath | unknown

evidence.excerpt: Mika stood at the edge of the elevated command platform, surveying the assembled remnants of Geralt's army—warriors who'd followed him through impossible battles and somehow survived.
